description: Defines the LogView class, a custom TextView that formats and displays log data received through the LogNode interface, including handling log levels, tags, messages, and exceptions. It supports chaining with other LogNode objects and is used for outputting logs within an Android app's UI.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays formatted log messages and supports chaining for log processing.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then appends it to the LogView UI component while ensuring thread safety. It also passes the log message to the next LogNode in the chain if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
